repeat_diagnostic.aggregation: Arithmetic mean of the five archived per-song rates, which were already rounded; not pooled event counts.
repeat_diagnostic.historical_method: D: early free rewrite of repeated action text, at most 3 groups and at most one call per group.
repeat_diagnostic.formula: D(P) = 1 - number_of_distinct_normalized_action_strings / number_of_events; 0 for an empty plan.
repeat_diagnostic.normalization: Lowercase; replace characters outside [a-z0-9 ] with spaces; collapse whitespace.
repeat_diagnostic.provenance_boundary: The archived summary labels these as verbatim repetition. The retained implementation specifies normalized exact strings; original plans and execution-time producer hashes are not locally archived.
repeat_diagnostic.interpretation: Directly targeted lexical diagnostic; not independent evidence of motion diversity, music alignment, or choreographic quality.

fair_presentation_contrast.score: Four text-judge criteria, each 1-5; total maximum 20; two-order mean.
fair_presentation_contrast.comparison: Vocabulary-preserving D3 versus earlier free-rewrite D.
caveats: 400 characters is the recorded presentation limit; the archive claims neither compared arm was truncated.
The six-song aggregate includes nominal test songs inspected during development.
A confidence interval spanning zero does not prove equivalence.
This is not an evaluation of the newer five-group Jaccard-threshold revision algorithm.

scope: Historical diagnostics only. Do not merge these rates or contrasts with results for the current bar-aligned protocol or the newer Jaccard >=0.80 revision variant. No new experiments were run.
